description: This file contains unit tests for the ConfigStore component, testing its load and save functions in both remote and local modes. The tests ensure correct routing of operations depending on the mode, using overrides and verifying behavior with expectations.

classes.name: ConfigStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for ConfigStore, containing multiple unit tests for load and save methods.

methods.name: `load uses remote in remote mode`
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() uses remote loading when in remote mode.

methods.name: `load uses local in local mode`
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() uses local loading when not in remote mode.

methods.name: save routes to remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save() routes to remote saving in remote mode.

methods.name: save routes to local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save() routes to local saving in local mode.
